verdict_reason: Accurate description of the new MDM product paths; only a Minor omission of the short-query 400 and later-page behaviour.

todos.issue: The MDM product search section leaves out two behaviours ProductController.search has: a q shorter than 2 characters answers 400 with {"error":"q must be at least 2 characters"}, and only page 0 of a saved term is held, so page 1 onwards answers an empty content array with the saved totals. A reader driving the stub from reference-data or the frontend cannot learn either from the README.
todos.fix: Must: the README states every answer the search path gives: the saved page, the empty page for an unsaved term, the empty later pages, and the 400 for a short q. One way: add those two sentences to the paragraph at line 82.
